name: @tjalve/aie
description: AI Executor - autonomous GitHub issue execution for agentic development.
author: tjalve

scripts.build:deps: pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/qube-core run build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/qube-adapter-github run build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/qube-adapter-gitlab run build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/qube-adapter-linear run build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/qube-adapter-jira run build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/qube-adapter-jenkins run build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/qube-adapter-codex run build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/qube-adapter-claude-code run build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/qube-adapter-opencode run build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/qube-adapter-grok-build run build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build && node test/run-node-tests.mjs
scripts.test:fast: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build && node test/run-node-tests.mjs --fast
scripts.pack:check: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build && pnpm pack --dry-run --json && node ../../scripts/restore-publish-dependencies.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run pack:check
